title: The Pro-Parenting Study: Helping Parents Reduce Behavior Problems in Preschool Children With Developmental Delay
brief_summary: The Pro-Parenting Study seeks to determine the added benefit of targeting both parenting stress and parent management strategies to more effectively reduce behavior problems among children with developmental delay (DD). Findings from this study will improve the scientific understanding of evidence-based interventions for behavior problems among children with DD and the mechanisms underlying therapeutic change.
